messages:
Maya (PM): FYI Acme asked for per-route throughput caps + a purchasable burst addon. They want predictable billing and an explicit ceiling. Need alignment on pricing shape and contract constraints.
Sam (AE): Confirmed. Their use-case: stable baseline for product pages, temporary spikes for marketing pushes. Willing to pay for bursts but wants clear liability limits.
Ben (Solutions): Sales sees two commercial shapes: 1) soft cap + paid burst credits (easier GTM), 2) hard cap with negotiated overage. Need to define what a "credit" buys (tokens, seconds, priority).
Lina (Eng): Tech options & rough effort: soft cap (warnings + metrics) 1 sprint; hard cap (rejects with 429) 2 sprints; priority lane (burst bank + routing priority) 6 sprints.
Maya (PM): Lina 1 can you paste a brief sketch for the burst-bank mechanics for Legal/Sales?
Lina (Eng): Sketch:
```
route_id: string
baseline_qps: int
soft_cap_pct: int // emit warning
burst_bank: credits_total int, credits_window_secs int, consumption_rate float
fallback: degrade | reject | route-to-lowcost
```
Ben (Solutions): Sales will want conversion examples (e.g., 100k credits ~= 1k TPS for 10m). Publish a table.
Devon (Legal): Contract asks: define credits and expiry, fair-use for sustained spikes, liability cap for degraded perf during bursts, termination for abuse, billing reconciliation for partial-window usage. Need audit log requirement (who purchased/consumed). :page_facing_up:
Priya (GTM): Recommend pilot before GA: Acme + a different workload (streaming app). Dashboards needed: credit balance, per-route consumption, cost estimate for overages.
Maya (PM): Draft launch criteria:
- Console controls to set baseline and buy credits (UI + API)
- Billing events for credits consumed per cycle
- Route dashboards + threshold alerts
- Contract language + examples
- 1 signed pilot + 1 engineering smoke test on dedicated infra
- Post-pilot SLO review window (2w)
Can Eng commit to MVP (soft cap + credits purchase + metrics) in 2 sprints?
Lina (Eng): Yes for MVP assumptions: no priority routing, no cross-region bursting. Need Console tickets + billing events.
Sam (AE): Sales ops needs SKU names and price bands for pilot. I'll draft Small (100k/mo) and Medium (1M/mo) with per-credit overage.
Ben (Solutions): Suggest unlimited credits for first 30 days of pilot to simplify testing.
Devon (Legal): Add audit log to compliance checklist (buyer id, route, timestamps).
ops-bot: Reminder: sprint planning in 30m.
Maya (PM): Action items:
- Lina: tech RFC + ETA EOD tomorrow
- Ben/Sam: pilot commercial terms + conversion examples ETA 48h
- Devon: contract clauses + audit log ETA 3 days
- Priya: dashboard mocks + pilot comms ETA 72h
Ben (Solutions): I'll also prepare a short FAQ for Sales.
Maya (PM): Target pilot kickoff next week. :rocket:
